interface.title: HDV Disposition Optimizer (Heavy-Duty-Vehicle Fleet Disposition Optimizer)
interface.field: Transport / energy systems: planning electric and diesel truck fleets, charging and vehicle-to-grid (V2G)
interface.stage_of_work: Scenario modelling and optimisation (setting up inputs, configuring and running mixed-integer solves, reviewing results)
interface.what_it_is_for: Plan one day for a mixed diesel/battery truck fleet: which truck runs which trip, when it charges, when it sells energy back to the grid (V2G), and which drivers it needs. It can also size a fleet over a range of days or sweep cost scenarios, years and V2G/external-charging settings.

data.note: Four example Excel workbooks in inputs/ (fleet: 10 trucks, 5 diesel (ICE) and 5 battery (BEV); depot: 5 × 400 kW chargers, metered load, 300 kWp PV; costs: energy_yearly and energy_daily; orders) plus derived files that were already built (117 trips over 5 days, 22–26.06.2026). In this install, addresses are geocoded offline by hashing each address onto a deterministic random point, so routed distances are not real (for example, Fulda to Großenlüder routes as 255.7 km in screens/010.webp). Every solve started in this install failed because the bundled Gurobi licence is size-limited. The results reviewed here are therefore the two disposition result CSVs that ship with the app (day 1, best case, 2025, V2G on and V2G off), opened from 5 · Results → Previous Results.

features.name: Run-mode switch with live run summary

features.specific: Disposition / Asset Sizing / Scenario Sweep segmented control. A date or day-range slider and scenario dropdowns feed metric cards (dates, days, trips, fleet size, electrification, chargers, MIP gap, solves).
